name: Generation To Generation
overview: Scripture reveals a profound continuity of God's character and human responsibility from generation to generation. Exodus 20:5 emphasizes the serious consequences of sin extending to the third and fourth generations of those who reject God, while Exodus 34:6 highlights God's enduring mercy and grace. The Psalms affirm the call to proclaim God's power and works across generations, with Psalm 71:18 expressing a desire to demonstrate God's strength to both the present and future generations, and Psalm 145:4 affirming that one generation will declare God's mighty acts to the next.
